purpose: Evaluate frozen SW0 only on A+B result rows whose first_set, second_set and third_set are each singleton integer lists. Non-singleton or empty rank-set rows are excluded from predictive scoring rather than scalarized because authoritative tie-parser semantics were not established.

preconditions: Fresh verify a NEW exact Owner Gate bound to this prereg/evaluator/test is authorized and unused
verify exact result SHA256 and prediction SHA256
verify evaluator and test Git blobs plus SHA256 values
derive exact A+B allowlist from frozen prediction race_id values and require exactly 1500 races
protected_scan: skip every non-A+B row without deserializing outcome fields
for A+B only require exact seven-field schema first_set/parser/race_date/race_id/second_set/status/third_set
require parser exactly result-v4.1-tie-aware, status str, race_date str
require all three rank-set fields to be integer unique lists and pairwise disjoint
score a row only when rank-set shape is exactly 1-1-1
for any other shape, exclude from predictive scoring and aggregate only the shape count; do not scalarize or impute

coverage_gate.derivation: Gate #485 marginal non-singleton counts imply at most 13 rows can fail the 1-1-1 condition by union bound; requiring >=1487 is an integrity/coverage check, not a performance threshold.

metrics.primary: mean exact ordered-top3 log-loss effect = uniform exact NLL minus SW0 exact NLL on strict-singleton rows
secondary: winner multiclass Brier score and uniform improvement

classification_rule.STRONG_PREDICTIVE_SIGNAL_STRICT_SINGLETO: pooled primary effect >0, bootstrap lower bound >0, A effect >0, B effect >0, and pooled winner Brier improvement >0
classification_rule.POSITIVE_BUT_UNCERTAIN_STRICT_SINGLETON_: pooled primary effect >0 but not all STRONG conditions

explicit_non_authority: no scoring of non-singleton/empty tie-aware rows
no DEV2000 C outcome-value deserialization or use
no provider contact, credentials, spend, Runtime, live betting, or automatic betting
post_evaluation_rule: Exactly one predictive evaluation attempt under a separate NEW exact Owner Gate. Persist result and receipt, consume the Gate on success or fail-closed, and do not rerun or alter metrics based on the observed performance.
